headlines.title: Sparks fly as Abdul El-Sayed and Mike Rogers face off in first Michigan Senate debate
headlines.description: Facing questions about gas prices, the war in Iran and tariffs, the candidates frequently exchanged insults amid a high-stakes campaign.

headlines.title: Raffensperger says he hasn't spoken to Trump since 2021 call asking him to 'find' votes
headlines.description: Georgia Secretary of State Brad Raffensberger (R), who President Trump called after the 2020 election to “find" him more than 11,000 votes, tells NBC News that ballots in the state will be counted securely and accurately. NBC News senior reporter Jane Timm joins Meet the Press NOW to break down her interview.

headlines.title: Texas Senate candidate James Talarico off the trail with the flu
headlines.description: In final stretch of the Texas Senate race, Talarico has not appeared in person since Sept. 26; he is expected to be back this weekend.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: USS Abraham Lincoln sailors reunite with loved ones after nearly a year away
headlines.description: Thousands of sailors and Marines aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln returned home after a record-long deployment. They got a chance to hug their loved ones, and some new dads got a chance to hold their babies for the first time. NBC News’ Courtney Kube was there.

headlines.title: Execution of Fort Hood shooter to be livestreamed
headlines.description: The Pentagon said it will livestream the execution of the Fort Hood shooter who killed 13 people in 2009. President Trump has ordered the execution will be by firing squad. NBC News’ Kelly O’Donnell reports.

headlines.title: Hurricane Isaias set to slam Gulf Coast
headlines.description: Families are racing to prepare with some ordered to evacuate as Hurricane Isaias closes in. Isaias rapidly intensified and accelerated as it roared toward the coast. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch is in the storm zone.

headlines.title: ICE officers shoot man in New York City
headlines.description: A man was taken to the hospital after ICE officers shot him in New York City, according to the Department of Homeland Security. Mayor Mamdani has responded to the shooting saying it was an "unconscionable" situation. The investigation is ongoing.

headlines.title: Clashes erupt between French police and protesters demanding better schools
headlines.description: Police charged demonstrators with clubs and fired tear gas as protesters resisted a crackdown, vowing to keep fighting for what they say are France’s broken schools. NBC News’ Richard Engel reports.

headlines.title: Ithaca city council calls on Cornell to report sexual assault investigations to local police
headlines.description: The Ithaca Common Council’s vote comes after a former student’s allegation that she was gang-raped wasn’t shared with local police during the initial investigation.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: Navalnaya leads Nobel Peace Prize favorites as Trump doubts odds
headlines.description: This year’s Nobel Peace Prize frontrunners include Yulia Navalnaya, Vanessa Nakate and Sudan’s Emergency Response Rooms. Donald Trump says he thinks he won’t win.
